title.narrative: Promoting Youth Well-being, Sport Values and Integrity through Fit for Life in Central Asia and Pakistan

description.narrative: This project will provide catalytic support to promote youth well-being, sport values, ethics and integrity across Central Asia and Pakistan, building on UNESCO’s Fit for Life approach. It will focus on low-cost capacity-building, awareness-raising and knowledge exchange with youth stakeholders, educators, sport actors and relevant institutions, encouraging inclusive participation, healthy lifestyles, anti-doping awareness, safeguarding and the use of sport as a tool for social cohesion.
